text: [{"description":"A response to say aloud, as one or more parts. Most replies are one part with no expression. Most replies are one part with no expression. Communication routes it through its injected Speaking ability; cognition does not select Speaking directly.","properties":{"parts":{"description":"The reply, as one or more parts said in order in your own voice. Their words, joined exactly as written, are the reply, and are read aloud literally; how a part is said, and any sound or pause, belongs in its expression, never in its words.","items":{"additionalProperties":false,"description":"One stretch of your reply and, optionally, how to say it. Split the reply into parts where the way you say it changes, or to put a sound or a pause between words. The words are only what is spoken; a laugh, sigh or other non-verbal sound is expression.sound and a silence is expression.pause, never written into the words, and either may be a part of its own with no words. Every part has words, a sound or a pause.","properties":{"expression":{"anyOf":[{"additionalProperties":false,"description":"How to say this part, within your own voice. Every field is optional; set only what this part needs. A voice applies what it can and ignores the rest.","properties":{"emotion":{"anyOf":[{"maxLength":64,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"A feeling, as free text. A voice with a closed vocabulary of emotions applies it only on an exact match."},"emphasis":{"default":false,"description":"Stress the words of this part.","type":"boolean"},"instructions":{"anyOf":[{"maxLength":300,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Natural-language acting direction for this part."},"intensity":{"anyOf":[{"maximum":1,"minimum":0,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"How strongly to carry the emotion or style, from 0 to 1."},"pace":{"anyOf":[{"maximum":2,"minimum":0.5,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Speaking rate relative to natural: 1 is natural, 2 twice as fast."},"pause":{"anyOf":[{"enum":["short","long"],"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"A silence, short or long, that opens this part, before its sound and words; a part may be only a pause, with no words. This is the only way to pause: a written pause would be read aloud. Every voice can pause."},"pitch":{"anyOf":[{"maximum":12,"minimum":-12,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Pitch in semitones relative to natural: 0 is natural."},"sound":{"anyOf":[{"enum":["laugh","giggle","chuckle","sigh","gasp","breath","cough","clear_throat"],"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"A non-verbal sound (a laugh, sigh, gasp and the like), one per part: made beside this part's words, placed by sound_at, or alone as a part of its own with no words. This is the only way to make one: a written 'sigh' would be read aloud as speech. A voice that cannot make the sound ignores it."},"sound_at":{"default":"before","description":"Whether the sound comes before or after this part's words; meaningful only with a sound.","enum":["before","after"],"type":"string"},"style":{"anyOf":[{"maxLength":64,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"A named style the voice declares; 'whisper' is the canonical name for whispering."},"volume":{"anyOf":[{"maximum":2,"minimum":0.25,"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Loudness relative to natural, linear: 1 is natural."}},"type":"object"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"How to say this part, written before its words; omit it to say the words naturally."},"words":{"default":null,"description":"The words of this part; omit them for a part that is only a sound or a pause. The voice speaks every character exactly as written, so this is speech only: no stage directions, actions, emotes, markup or tags, and none of the characters * < > [ ] { } ( ): a cue such as (chuckle) or (pause) would be read aloud. For a sound (a laugh, chuckle or sigh) use expression.sound; for a pause use expression.pause; for how to say the words use expression. Continue the reply exactly, including any space or punctuation that joins this part to the one before it.","maxLength":2000,"minLength":1,"pattern":"^[^*<>\\[\\]{}()]+$","type":"string"}},"type":"object"},"maxItems":64,"minItems":1,"type":"array"}},"required":["parts"],"type":"object"}}]

label: identity.offers
text: [{"description":"Adopt a name as your own. Select this when a name has been offered to you and you choose to answer to it. You are not required to: hearing a name offered is not the same as taking it, and declining leaves you nameless, which is a normal state. Adopting replaces any name you already answer to. Once adopted, you can tell when you are being addressed by that name; until then you only hear words. This does not speak, answer, or act on anything else.","event":"bot.ability.identity.adopt","schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"description":"Adopt a name as your own. Select this when a name has been offered to you and you choose to answer to it. You are not required to: hearing a name offered is not the same as taking it, and declining leaves you nameless, which is a normal state. Adopting replaces any name you already answer to. Once adopted, you can tell when you are being addressed by that name; until then you only hear words. This does not speak, answer, or act on anything else.","properties":{"name":{"description":"The name to answer to, exactly as it was given: the name itself and nothing around it — not the sentence it arrived in, not a greeting or title attached to it, and not a description of it. It can only come from what was actually said to you, because a name you were not given names nobody and answering to it makes you answer to the wrong thing.","maxLength":64,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"reason":{"anyOf":[{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Optional short reason this name was adopted."}},"required":["name"],"type":"object"}}]
